metric_policy.role_topk: Full known date/scope denominator; missing any score makes rank incomplete; separate ranked-only diagnostic
metric_policy.core_summary: All eleven independent role positives on complete-label groups; unknown scores remain misses; HEIGHT does not certify total core
metric_policy.rear_position: Two qualified matching blind reviews with evidence; never inferred from model score or board rank
metric_policy.invalidation: First independently observed loss and last positive before that loss; reacquisition separate
metric_policy.window: 120 consecutive verified official sessions plus exact mature target horizon; missing calendar fails closed

interval_policy: Every one of the fixed2000 all-type draws must have defined F1; never discard undefined draws and condition on the survivors
